header.description: Hours baseline (Arithmetic in the Wild, arXiv:2605.01148): no-intervention accuracy on all 1,152 hours prompts (24 concepts x 48 spelled-out offsets, the paper template with a trailing space so the zero-padded hour is the single next token - hence token_form 'bare': the prompt already ends in the space, so the answer '01' is emitted with none before it, and the space-prefixed form would name a token the model never produces). Golden: paper reports 70.8%; band [0.65, 0.75] around the paper's figure.
